entries.doc:
Generate a schema unrelated to the current context.
Use this function if e.g. you are handling schema generation for a sequence
and want to generate a schema for its items.
Otherwise, you may end up doing something like applying a `min_length` constraint
that was intended for the sequence itself to its items!

Args:
    source_type: The input type.

Returns:
    CoreSchema: The `pydantic-core` CoreSchema generated.
entries.doc_summary: Generate a schema unrelated to the current context. Use this function if e.g. you are handling schema generation for a sequence and want to generate a schema for its items. Otherwise, you may end up doing something like applying a `min_length` constraint that was intended for the sequence itself to its items!

entries.doc:
Get the real schema for a `definition-ref` schema.
If the schema given is not a `definition-ref` schema, it will be returned as is.
This means you don't have to check before calling this function.

Args:
    maybe_ref_schema: A `CoreSchema`, `ref`-based or not.

Raises:
    LookupError: If the `ref` is not found.

Returns:
    A concrete `CoreSchema`.
entries.doc_summary: Get the real schema for a `definition-ref` schema. If the schema given is not a `definition-ref` schema, it will be returned as is. This means you don't have to check before calling this function.

entries.doc:
Get the real schema for a `{"$ref": ...}` schema.
If the schema given is not a `$ref` schema, it will be returned as is.
This means you don't have to check before calling this function.

Args:
    maybe_ref_json_schema: A JsonSchemaValue which may be a `$ref` schema.

Raises:
    LookupError: If the ref is not found.

Returns:
    JsonSchemaValue: A JsonSchemaValue that has no `$ref`.
entries.doc_summary: Get the real schema for a `{"$ref": ...}` schema. If the schema given is not a `$ref` schema, it will be returned as is. This means you don't have to check before calling this function.

entries.doc:
Call the inner handler and get the CoreSchema it returns.
This will call the next CoreSchema modifying function up until it calls
into Pydantic's internal schema generation machinery, which will raise a
`pydantic.errors.PydanticSchemaGenerationError` error if it cannot generate
a CoreSchema for the given source type.

Args:
    source_type: The input type.

Returns:
    CoreSchema: The `pydantic-core` CoreSchema generated.
entries.doc_summary: Call the inner handler and get the CoreSchema it returns. This will call the next CoreSchema modifying function up until it calls into Pydantic's internal schema generation machinery, which will raise a `pydantic.errors.PydanticSchemaGenerationError` error if it cannot generate a CoreSchema for the given source type.

entries.doc:
Call the inner handler and get the JsonSchemaValue it returns.
This will call the next JSON schema modifying function up until it calls
into `pydantic.json_schema.GenerateJsonSchema`, which will raise a
`pydantic.errors.PydanticInvalidForJsonSchema` error if it cannot generate
a JSON schema.

Args:
    core_schema: A `pydantic_core.core_schema.CoreSchema`.

Returns:
    JsonSchemaValue: The JSON schema generated by the inner JSON schema modify
    functions.
entries.doc_summary: Call the inner handler and get the JsonSchemaValue it returns. This will call the next JSON schema modifying function up until it calls into `pydantic.json_schema.GenerateJsonSchema`, which will raise a `pydantic.errors.PydanticInvalidForJsonSchema` error if it cannot generate a JSON schema.
